instruction: Switch GIMP's icon theme to Symbolic-Inverted.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened GIMP, navigated to Edit > Preferences > Theme, observed available themes (Dark, Gray, Light, System), checked Icon Theme section (Color, Legacy, Symbolic, Symbolic-High-Contrast, Symbolic-Inverted, Symbolic-Inverted-High-Contrast), and correctly declared the original Blue theme task infeasible.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can launch GIMP from app launcher, navigate Edit > Preferences, browse Theme and Icon Theme sections, read available icon theme options
metadata.task_rationale: The agent browsed the Icon Theme section during the trajectory, demonstrating it can navigate there. This variation tests actually changing the icon theme to Symbolic-Inverted, which the agent saw in the list.
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing GIMP icon theme to Symbolic-Inverted via Edit > Preferences > Icon Theme. Evaluator reads gimprc config file and checks that icon-theme is set to Symbolic-Inverted. [Fixed: changed rules from nested expected dict to flat key/value format matching check_config_status signature, added literal quotes around value to match gimprc S-expression parsing]
fix_history: Fix 1: Changed rules from {"expected": {"icon-theme": "Symbolic-Inverted"}} to {"key": "icon-theme", "value": "\"Symbolic-Inverted\""} to match check_config_status(actual_config_path, rule) which accesses rule['key'] and rule['value']. Value includes literal double quotes because gimprc stores strings as S-expressions e.g. (icon-theme "Symbolic-Inverted") and the parser preserves quotes.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: gimp_config_file reads ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc and saves it locally for metric evaluation.

Metric logic is correct: check_config_status receives rules dict {"key": "icon-theme", "value": "\"Symbolic-Inverted\""} and correctly accesses rule['key'] and rule['value'] to match against parsed gimprc lines.

Data flow is correct: gimprc line '(icon-theme "Symbolic-Inverted")' is parsed by stripping parens and splitting by whitespace, yielding items[0]='icon-theme' and items[-1]='"Symbolic-Inverted"', which match the expected key and value (value includes literal quotes to match S-expression format).
Instruction coverage is complete: the single requirement (switch icon theme to Symbolic-Inverted) is fully verified by checking the icon-theme setting in gimprc.

Previous judgment was based on pre-fix state. The rules have since been corrected from nested {expected: {icon-theme: ...}} format to flat {key, value} format matching check_config_status expectations.
